narrative.overview:
A flat, high-contrast print sheet. Warm milk paper carries the ground, grill charcoal carries the structure (type, the hero slab, the tab bar), and one electric Turbo blue marks the thing to act on right now: the primary button, the active tab, links, the live figure's action. It refuses the category defaults of the dark neon dashboard and the soft pastel card stack.

Density is phone-first and arm's-length readable: heavy, tight-tracked Inter Tight figures, big 50px buttons, cards separated by thin warm rules instead of shadows. The one moment of depth is floating chrome, the charcoal tab bar, which sits on a single soft offset shadow. Motion is critically damped springs with press-down scaling; nothing glows.
keyCharacteristics: 60-30-10 split of milk, charcoal and Turbo on every screen.
One live number per screen, set in heavy tabular Inter Tight.
Charcoal hero slab that renders its contents in the dark palette in both modes.
Square-ish corners (6-14px), thin warm rules (1.5px on themed controls), sharp-cornered Material icons.
Floating charcoal tab bar with a solid Turbo block for the active tab.

rules.name: The 60-30-10 Rule
rules.body: Milk paper about 60% of a screen, charcoal about 30%, Turbo about 10%. If two things on a screen are blue fills, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Fill vs Ink Rule
rules.body: Turbo fills are always exact `#1F4BFF` with white on top, in both modes. Turbo as text or icon colour on any dark ground is `t300`, never `#1F4BFF`.

rules.name: The Tabular Figure Rule
rules.body: Every number that can change (volume, sets, weight × reps, streaks, timers) uses `fontFeatures: tabularFigures` so digits never jitter.

rules.name: The 11px Floor Rule
rules.body: Nothing on screen is set below 11px.

rules.name: The No-Glow Rule
rules.body: No coloured shadows or glows around Turbo elements; Turbo is a flat ink block.

dos: **Do** resolve colours through `Pal.of(context)`; use `accent` for fills and `accentText` for Turbo-coloured text and icons.
**Do** keep Turbo to one primary action or active state per view, roughly 10% of the screen.
**Do** set every changing number in Inter Tight with `tabularFigures`.
**Do** use `separator` rules (prefer `AppTheme.borderWidth`, 1.5px) and tone for separation, and token radii (6/8/12/14px).
**Do** wrap any charcoal slab's contents in `AppTheme.darkTheme` so they read in the dark palette.
donts: **Don't** put `#1F4BFF` text or icons on charcoal or any dark ground; use `t300`.
**Don't** add glows, coloured shadows or gradients-as-decoration; the only real shadow is on floating chrome.
**Don't** use muscle-group inks, success or danger as brand accents.
**Don't** go below 11px type or below 44px tap targets.
**Don't** introduce pure grey or pure black; stay on the warm `n050`-`n950` ramp.
